item.title: FloodCastCL Wins VIU 2026 Funding to Advance Flood Early Warning
item.description: The project FloodCastCL: A flood early warning system for critical catchments in Chile, led by civil engineer Héctor Garcés-Figueroa, has been awarded funding through the 2026 Valorización de la Investigación en la Universidad (VIU) competition of Chile’s National Research and Development Agency (ANID), with Universidad de La Frontera as the beneficiary institution.

item.title: Frontal system in south-central Chile: 2 deaths, 6,183 isolated people and rivers under stress [30 July - 2 August 2026]
